preMovePostBinding.preRoot: authoritative RAW state immediately before canonical legal move m
preMovePostBinding.move: canonical legal move identity bound to preRoot
preMovePostBinding.postRoot: complete engine.applyMove(preRoot,m).state after all relay, finishTurn, player switch and any phase transition
primaryEligibility: direct move application does not produce relay-limit

preMovePostBinding.terminalPostMoveHandling: not a primary scientific unit; retained only as technical/source provenance

eventFamilies.eventDefinition: actual source move has move.type == capture
eventFamilies.identifiabilityReason: capture is mandatory; roots with an available capture do not provide legal non-capture alternatives
eventFamilies.controlDefinition: nearest earlier primary-eligible actual source move in the same source trajectory and same pre-phase with move.type != capture; search backward only to eventScanPlyStart and never across a phase boundary
eventFamilies.unitSelection: earliest comparable capture event per source trajectory

eventFamilies.eventDefinition: Namua capture root where engine.moveVariants exposes stop and use variants for the same physical opening move, the post RAW states differ, and use causes mover houseOwned true->false while stop retains mover houseOwned true
eventFamilies.pairBinding: same pre-root and same physical opening move fields except houseChoice
eventFamilies.unitSelection: earliest comparable root per source trajectory; if multiple physical moves qualify at that root, canonical-lowest physical move identity
eventFamilies.claimBoundary: same-root move-conditioned contrast; no general causal Bao mechanism claim

eventFamilies.eventDefinition: actual source move with pre.phase == namua and post.phase == mtaji
eventFamilies.mechanicalLink: the current engine changes to mtaji when both reserves reach zero; reserve exhaustion and Namua-to-Mtaji are therefore one linked compound event here
eventFamilies.controlDefinition: immediately preceding actual source move in the same source trajectory, requiring control pre.phase == namua, control post.phase == namua, mover reserve decrement exactly 1, and both control/event units primary-eligible
eventFamilies.unitSelection: the unique first comparable Namua-to-Mtaji transition per source trajectory
eventFamilies.claimBoundary: event-conditioned structural change around the linked reserve-exhaustion/phase-transition boundary; no separable causal reserve effect

eventFamilies.eventDefinition: pre.phase == namua, post.phase == namua, mover reserve decreases by exactly 1
eventFamilies.reason: generic Namua reserve decrement is phase-linked and lacks a same-root decrement/no-decrement contrast

integer global distinct RAW state count over relative depths 0..5
exact reduced rational duplicate encounter count divided by bounded transition occurrence count; denominator is sum uniqueTransitionCount[d] for d=0..4 as fixed before G3-05 fresh evidence
exact reduced rational cumulative tree node occurrence divided by global distinct RAW state count

exactArithmetic.rationalEndpoints: reduced numerator/denominator integer pairs with positive denominator
exactArithmetic.undefinedDenominator: candidate unit is non-comparable for that metric; no imputation

experimentalUnit.eventUnit: prospectively selected event/control pair bound to one source trajectory
experimentalUnit.candidateInferenceReduction: one exact event-minus-control contrast sign per source trajectory/event/metric

stage1Population.selection: seed ascending; earliest comparable event unit per event family per trajectory
stage1Population.ifTargetNotReachedWithinBlock: event family is STAGE1-NON-ESTIMABLE and produces no promoted candidate

stage1CandidateUniverse: all Cartesian products of formal event families E1,E2,E3 and metrics M1..M6; no event/metric may be added after fresh access

stage1PromotionGate.directionFreeze: sign with at least two-thirds of nonzero exact contrasts; ties or weaker dominance are not promoted

stage2Population.selection: seed ascending using identical event/control rules, after Stage 1 identity exclusion
stage2Population.ifTargetNotReachedWithinBlock: all promoted candidates in that event family are NON-ESTIMABLE

stage2FormalRule.testedSet: Stage 1 promoted candidate identities and frozen directions only
stage2FormalRule.test: exact two-sided sign test on nonzero trajectory-level event-minus-control contrast signs
stage2FormalRule.directionRequirement: dominant sign must equal Stage 1 frozen direction
stage2FormalRule.confirmed: all technical/estimability gates pass, frozen direction holds, and Holm-adjusted criterion passes
stage2FormalRule.notConfirmed: estimable candidate fails direction and/or multiplicity-aware test
stage2FormalRule.nonEstimable: required population, exactness, definition, or minimum-nonzero estimability gate fails without a global technical-invalid condition
